description: This file defines a React functional component 'ToolPermissionRulesEditor' that provides a user interface for editing tool permission guardrails, including rules, default actions, and disallowed actions. It manages state transformations and renders UI elements for configuring rules and constraints.

methods.name: ensureConfig
methods.description: Ensures the provided config has default values, filling in missing fields.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates the entire configuration object, optionally calling onChange callback.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Updates a specific rule within the rules array.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Adds a new default rule with a generated ID.

methods.name: removeRule
methods.description: Removes a rule at specified index.

methods.name: updateAllowedParamEntries
methods.description: Modifies allowed_param_patterns entries for a specific rule.

methods.name: updateAllowedParamPath
methods.description: Updates the path value in allowed_param_patterns.

methods.name: updateAllowedParamPattern
methods.description: Updates the regex pattern in allowed_param_patterns.

methods.name: renderAllowedParamPatterns
methods.description: Renders UI elements for managing parameter patterns.
